apm_unit_on_production_2020_2021.description: Hierarchical team-unit APM versus active opener picks
apm_unit_on_production_2020_2021.notes: Predeclared hierarchical APM; mined-era and prior APM/EPA selection discount. No admissible closing ground established. Covered games only; full policy in artifact.
apm_unit_on_production_2020_2021.plain_summary: Adding each side's offensive and defensive unit strength from play-level ratings to the model, checked against the opening line in 2020-21: it leaned against the idea (about 5% likely to help) but the range crosses zero, so it isn't settled.
